commands.text: A dead guard drags its weapon over the far stones. Others follow where the firm ground narrows.

commands.speaker: nara_vell
commands.text: Everyone behind the stop. This is the line we keep, not a line you join.

commands.speaker: marek_vane
commands.text: Read the one supporting the formation. The nearest blade is not the only threat.

commands.speaker: or_volunteer
commands.text: Do we move the people again?

commands.speaker: nara_vell
commands.text: They have safe room. Keep it clear for them.
The two step forward without asking the volunteers to hold a weapon.
